_comment: End-character vectors for the French punctuation ':' and ';' (maintainer decision HCD-2, 2026-11-21). A bare ':' or ';' ends a trigger on the three OS, and the no-break space (U+202F or U+00A0) the Ergopti layout types before them is looked past and replaced with the trigger. Replayed by the shared engine (linux/tests/unit/hotstrings/engine/engine/test_shared_hotstring_engine.lua), the Windows matcher (windows/tests/unit/hotstrings/engine/engine/test_end_character_vectors.ahk) and the macOS expander (macos/tests/unit/hotstrings/engine/expander/terminators/test_end_character_vectors.lua). Each vector registers `mappings` (absent flags are false), types `typed` one character at a time, ' ', ':' and ';' being end characters, and states whether the last character fires; `backspace_count` counts the codepoints the expansion replaces: the trigger, the stripped space and the end character.
